# Ibex Capital Mortgage

> Ibex Capital, Inc. (NMLS #2288114), a mortgage company in Encinitas, CA, licensed in California, Colorado, Montana, Texas, Florida. Offers purchase, refinance, conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo, 203(k) and DSCR loans. In other states it refers borrowers to licensed partner lenders. Phone 888-699-5777.

## Loans
- [Conventional loans](https://www.ibexcapitalmortgage.com/conventional-loans/)
- [FHA loans](https://www.ibexcapitalmortgage.com/fha-loans/)
- [VA loans](https://www.ibexcapitalmortgage.com/va-loans/)
- [USDA loans](https://www.ibexcapitalmortgage.com/usda-loans/)
- [Jumbo loans](https://www.ibexcapitalmortgage.com/jumbo-loans/)
- [Refinancing](https://www.ibexcapitalmortgage.com/refinance/)
- [DSCR & investment loans](https://www.ibexcapitalmortgage.com/dscr-loans/)
- [First-time buyers](https://www.ibexcapitalmortgage.com/first-time-homebuyers/)
- [Renovation (203k) loans](https://www.ibexcapitalmortgage.com/203k-loans/)
